_comment: THE SHIVAN GORGE PATH EXECUTES -- the positive control for edf_co_12 and for the sweep's
cluster C2 (rule GORGE: 17 offers, 0 wins before the fix).
USER: 'the third path would be Shivan Gorge, but that is only accessible with red mana on
board (fertile ground or trace of abundance) and Shivan Gorge already out + infinite mana.'
All three are here: the Gorge, a Fertile Ground for the red, and a live loop -- and the loop
has FIVE untap slots (Peregrine Drake), so the once-per-untap ping is genuinely repeatable
alongside four yield lands. 20 blinks, 21 pings, opponent dead.
The other half of the fix is what lets it run at all: SpendSurplusOnDamageSinks used to guard
itself with a POOLED CanPay projection, which passed and then let the real payment take the
board's last colourless source for a generic pip -- `STOP at k=4: pay-failed`, four blinks of
twenty. It now TRIALS the payment on a copy of the state (MTG_COMBO_OFF_SINK_TRIAL).
